steps.content: She climbs through the ventilation shaft onto the rooftop. The sky immediately stretches before her, just as the alarm begins to blare.

steps.speaker: Fraser Pursuer A
steps.content: The suspect has escaped! All units, assemble and begin search and capture immediately!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Discovered sooner than I'd hoped. A pity I have no intention of remaining as your guest. Your time to act has just run out!
She swiftly anchors the Aurum Secretum to a railing on the balcony below and leaps without hesitation.
Her descent accelerates, tempered by the Aurum Secretum and her own power. The ground rushes up to meet her, yet she lands as steadily as a cat.
[Scene Change: Luminaris Society]
Meanwhile, in a room somewhere within the Luminaris Society.

The surveillance footage tightens its focus on the girl who has touched down, capturing her as she darts and leaps across the rooftops, moving with nimble urgency toward the bustling central district.

steps.speaker: X·Raphael Herbert
steps.content: Is this what you call "already under control"? She appears to be moving with considerable freedom to me.

steps.speaker: V·Lana Kantarella
steps.content: Patience, Mr. Herbert. The fact that you came to the Society with me demonstrates your... curiosity about that technology. It would be best to observe with a calm mind.

steps.speaker: V·Lana Kantarella
steps.content: Hypatia Campbell is brilliant and tenacious, yet burdened by an oversensitive conscience and an exaggerated sense of personal duty. She internalizes blame for outcomes she did not cause; merely witnessing suffering is enough to make her shoulder the responsibility.

steps.speaker: V·Lana Kantarella
steps.content: Now, keep your eyes open and watch closely. The magic show is just beginning.
[Scene Change: Fraser Alley or Rooftop]
Twilight deepens as Hypatia races desperately through the maze of alleyways.
Her pursuers are behind her now. One more block, and she will be free.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Wind
steps.content: Hypa, Hypatia...

steps.speaker: Voice in the Wind
steps.content: Traitor!
The girl whirls around, but finds no one behind her. The alley stands utterly empty.
Yet after only a few more steps, the voice returns, and this time, it seems to come from just over her shoulder.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Wind
steps.content: Fool... you think you can outrun your guilt? Escape your duty? You promised you would save us...

steps.speaker: Trembling Voice
steps.content: Hehehe... look at you now! No home, no city-state. You've become just like us!

steps.speaker: Mocking Voice
steps.content: Where do you think you're going? Who would ever take you in now? Without the Campbell name, you're just another lost soul to fade into the WhiteSands!
With those voices, a powerful wave of dizziness floods Hypatia's mind. The ground beneath her feet seems to soften into quicksand. She staggers, misses her footing, and collapses onto the pale sand.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What's happening... My head... ugh...!
A sharp pain pierces the back of her neck. As the vertigo deepens, the hallucinations begin, even more impossible than before.
[Black Screen + Hallucinations]
The undulating sand rises into faces that laugh and shriek at her from below, surging and receding like waves beneath her body.
They are the faces of those from Furor who died violently, of Outland refugees twisted into alchemic beasts, of Fraser warriors fallen in battle.

The faces converge, interweave, and merge, dissolving at last into an indistinct, fluid mass of sand. It grows, spreads, enclosing her world like a restless, membranous womb, until it swallows her vision whole.
<color=#dg1f1f>She is sinking.</color>

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: Hypatia... Curse... Duty... Hypatia... Hypa...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: Do not go... Do not seek freedom... Do not... Hypatia...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: Leave your life here... Surrender everything... You made a promise...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: ————!
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: Youthful Voice
steps.content: I will be forever faithful to my duty, my city, and its people.
(End of Flashback)
Night has fallen. Deep in the alley, two pursuers have found their target.

steps.speaker: Fraser Pursuer A
steps.content: All units, target sighted. Subject is displaying signs of acute mental distress. Requesting authorization for immediate apprehension.

steps.speaker: Intercom
steps.content: Authorization granted. Proceed with capture.
Several soldiers advance swiftly, forming a tightening circle around Hypatia.
[Black Screen + Hallucinations]

The girl is surrounded by the curses of lost souls. Though her rational mind dismisses them as hallucinations, the struggle to breathe becomes a struggle for control. Her efforts to calm down only make it worse.
The chaotic noise persists; her consciousness grows hazy.
And a new torment emerges: her body aches as if beaten. Could this, too, be their revenge...?
(Flashback to oath-taking scene)
You are right. I should never have sought to leave. I swore to give all, and still, I have achieved nothing.
If you despise me so... if you demand my life in return... then if this is my penance...

steps.speaker: Fraser Pursuer B
steps.content: Target subdued. Confirmed unable to resist.

steps.speaker: Fraser Pursuer A
steps.content: Mission accomplished. Let's head back.
Rough hands haul Hypatia to her feet, fumbling for the shackles.
Then, a night breeze sweeps through the alley, cutting the stale air with a shock of pure, sweet lily. All eyes snap to the entrance, where a white figure stands in silhouette.

Golden heels gleam in the dimness. Under the shadow of a jade-green hat, a pearl-adorned glove holds a fan like a silken mask. Nothing shows above its edge but two eyes—twin crescents of amused delight.
To treat a lady with such heavy-handedness... Is this the conduct befitting a city-state that prides itself on civilization?
How regrettable. Might I suggest a more... diplomatic approach?

steps.speaker: Fraser Pursuer A
steps.content: Who are you?! Hands up!
A soft laugh floats down, and with it, several white feathers. The soldiers' eyes follow the gentle descent.
In that instant, the white figure materializes among them. With a delicate tap of the fan against each feather, a silent, rippling wave pulses through the air.
A sudden, profound calm washes over the soldiers. Weapons clatter to the ground in a dull chorus as an irresistible tide of peace stills their limbs.
Released, Hypatia slumps, only to be gathered effortlessly into the arms of the woman in white.
There, there, it's all right now. I won't let them harm you anymore.
Another feather drifts down, coming to rest upon Hypatia. Deep within the chaos of her mind, a point of pure white light appears. It fractures the void, shattering the shrieking noise into silence.
The pressure finally lifts. With a surge of effort, Hypatia pries her eyes open. Through the haze, a form in white resolves into a familiar silhouette.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Ms. ... Margaret...
It is the last thing she sees. As the last of her strength dissolves, the world tilts, softens, and fades to a profound dark again.
